description: This file defines the main explore/search page component for a document management platform interface built with React. It includes UI for searching, filtering by visibility and status, and displays a list of document summaries with actions to open individual documents.

methods.name: normalizeVisibility
methods.description: Converts a string input into a DocumentVisibility type or 'all'. Handles 'Private', 'Public', 'Unlisted' case-insensitively, defaults to 'all'.

methods.name: formatShortDate
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a human-readable date, or returns '—' if invalid or undefined.
